review.notes: Triage review of the 139-page report. Structure: full fence scan of all 3,909 OCR lines (17 balanced code blocks, none swallowing headings/tables/images) plus a whole-file heading inventory against printed box titles. Droppage: every PDF page was machine-scanned twice (normalized 4-gram containment and a missing-word scan), then pages with low containment or flagged lines were compared line by line against the PDF text layer; the flagged set covered pp. 1, 7, 8, 10-12, 27-28, 41, 44, 51, 57, 61, 68-69, 71, 89, 95, 104-105, 107, 111-117 plus the reference name check on pp. 120 and 138. Every patch was verified on a rendered page crop that was read visually (pp. 1, 57, 61, 89, 95, 120, 138). Not defects: the section-6.3 agentic loop flowchart (p.95) and the p.69 'Task:' panel labels are figure-internal and travel with embedded images; 'Veo 3, 5 2025' (p.121), 'PaiBench-G' casing (p.57) and the bold run-in headings of Appendix B are printed as such in the PDF; '\_' escapes render as the printed underscores (e.g. has_face); reference trailing numbers are printed page back-links; the p.89 prompt box uses straight quotes and hyphen-for-em-dash consistently with the box's monospace print.
